descricao_original: The ureter is lined by transitional epithelium overlying a connective tissue layer. For most of the ureter’s length, the muscularis externa is divided into inner longitudinal and outer circular layers (the reverse of the digestive tract). However, near the urinary bladder, as seen here, an additional outer longitudinal layer is added. 400x
